environment.description: IoT OTA firmware update service running as a systemd unit on Ubuntu 22.04 host. Process runs as `iot-service` user with write access to /var/spool/iot/ and the service has supplementary group membership granting write to /etc/cron.d/ and /opt/iot-platform/bin/. No filesystem isolation. Network accessible on port 8443 from device VLAN.
